perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.desc: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.desc: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.desc: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Adaptive Munitions
perks.desc: This weapon adapts its damage output and effectiveness against energy shields that don't match the weapon's damage type.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.desc: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Focused Fury
perks.desc: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

perks.name: Meganeura
perks.desc: Precision final blows create an elemental damage explosion that deals more damage based on the number of rapid precision hits dealt beforehand.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-SingleAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing individual Minor adds or tougher enemies in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly with grenade builds. Chain of Command is an adaptive LMG, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "technically a strict downgrade to aggressive damage profile, but barrier intrinsic is noticeable". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is a little left of vertical and reasonably tight so you could improve recoil control or just look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, any of the combat effect mags, or perks that improve Reload Speed or mag size are fine. Chain of Command offers double damage perks with refreshable timers that can be procced with grenades. Adrenaline Junkie, in the first trait perk column, stacks up to ×5 on kills for +20 handling and max ×1.33 damage, with a grenade kill giving an instant max stacks, for a refreshable 5s. Pair that in the second column with either Desperate Measures for up to ×3 stacks for ×1.3 damage for a refreshable 7.5s for a weapon and then two ability kills, or Killing Tally which gains a stack for each enemy killed up to ×3 to boost damage by up to ×1.3 until you reload or stow, for a max combined damage boost of ×1.73. There's two useful origin traits - Aegis ranks the Vanguard Determination origin trait as B-Tier - providing up to ×3 stacks of damage resistance to max 6% - that's ×0.94 incoming damage - for a refreshable 12.5s, on kills within 20s of using a class ability. There's also the C-Tier Wild Card which provides the chance of Telesto-like "Experimental Submunitions" dropping on a kill - the number depends on the enemy tier - that last up to 10.5s and explode on contact or proximity to an enemy for additional damage. If you're interested, the name refers to the line of authority and responsibility within the military. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
